units: <cite ref="Menachot 35a">Men. 35ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 24b:18">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>בתָפְרָן ובאלכסונן</he> (or <he>בתִפְרָן</he>; Rashi <he>בתוֹפְרָן</he>), v. <cite ref="A01891"><he>אֲלַכְסוֹן</he></cite>. Men. l. c. <he>צריך … למקום הת׳</he> the grooves (marking the division of the compartments of the T’fillin) must reach to where the seam (the border) sets in.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:1">Kel. XXIII, 1</cite> <he>מפני שהת׳ מחברו</he> because the seam joins it (makes the stuffing and the cover one body).
